quest.title: The End of the Road
quest.description: Having obtained the permit, the time has arrived for you to activate the Secret Source Dragon Idol and enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Dragon Idol
dialogues.text: (The Secret Source Dragon Idol that stands here... bears ancient signs of Abyssal corrosion...)

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Dragon Idol
dialogues.text: (Perhaps we should give it the permit and the replacement "energy"?)

talks.objective: Activate the Secret Source Dragon Idol

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've cleaned out almost all of the Abyss-stuff here, and we got the permit from the Chamber of Deliberation...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess it's time to head to the sacred mountain's entrance, then!
